text: Kestrel planning covers six modules: scheduler, checkout, catalog, indexer, webhooks, and profile. Checkout is assigned to gamma (batch_size 750, timeout_s 20), and indexer is owned by worker alpha (retry_limit 9, timeout_s 15). Several constraints apply: if indexer's timeout_s exceeds 5, catalog's max_workers must be at least 32; if checkout's timeout_s exceeds 10, webhooks' ttl_s must be at most 90. Webhooks and profile share a worker, while checkout and profile must never share one. Webhooks must not depend on scheduler, even indirectly, and both scheduler and webhooks depend on indexer. Webhooks owns types.py and mapper.py. Indexer must roll out before checkout, and code review turnaround stays under one day. Left to the team are profile's timeout_s (around 15 was suggested) and catalog's delta sync. Old-system load tests and error rates are not comparable to the new plan.
